resources.string: You usually won\'t need it: if you still have a device or a family member with KidBox, you can get back in from there.
Save it now: you\'ll only see it this once. It works for all your families and on every device.
If you lose this code and all your devices, and no family member has the app, encrypted data can\'t be recovered.
Print it or save it in your phone\'s password manager. Don\'t save it in KidBox Passwords: they open with the same key this code is meant to recover.
Type the characters of the code at the positions shown.
That doesn\'t match: check the code you saved.
Your vault was just created on another device: open it with that code.
Invalid code: make sure you typed all of it correctly.
Lost your code? If you still have a device or a family member with KidBox, you can get back in from there.
Your family\'s key is protected. Not even KidBox can open it.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
KidBox documents, passwords and photos are encrypted with a key only your family has. To get it back on a new phone or computer, save a recovery code. Not even KidBox can open it.
You only need to do this once on this device: type the recovery code you saved.
